fixtures.preview: Mauricio Pochettino, who takes his first training on Thu 19 Nov, is due to take charge at Anfield (3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney) after only three training days.
talking_points: Pochettino replaces the sacked Michael Carrick on a deal to summer 2029; Sky Sports News understands United must pay about £7.4m to free him from the USA job.
United are 18th with 8 points from 10 (one win, five draws, four losses), their worst-ever Premier League start, per Sky's table of 8 Nov.
Liverpool were 4th on 18 points as of 8 Nov, and sit 8th in the Champions League table on 9 points; United are 17th on 6.
Pochettino is expected to hold his first press conference on Friday, per DaveOCKOP, so team news should firm up then.
Line-ups and injuries aren't confirmed, so it's unclear who Pochettino can pick.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon (8pm local, 7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney), with United 17th on 6 points and Sporting 10th on 9 after four games.
Brentford (8th, 14 points as of 8 Nov) visit Old Trafford at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney), probably Pochettino's home debut.
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at 8pm UK time (7am Thu 3 Dec Sydney) against a 12th-placed side on 12 points as of 8 Nov; the schedule is subject to change.
Coventry, one place above United in 17th on 9 points as of 8 Nov, visit at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 6 Dec Sydney) in a relegation-zone six-pointer.
Sydney go to Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney) off a 4-1 win over Central Coast on 6 Nov.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure scored his second hat-trick for the club in the 4-1 win over the Mariners, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first goal for Sydney.
Patrick Kisnorbo said after that win that 'the best is yet to come'.
Sydney were 2nd on 7 points from 4 games and Brisbane 3rd on 7 from 3 as of 8 Nov (not re-checked).
The squad for Brisbane isn't named yet, and no injury list has been published.

fixtures.preview: The Big Blue at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm.

Socceroos v Jordan has been removed as it has been played; I couldn't find a result. Other big matches (Nations Championship, Champions League) were not re-checked today.

Arts: details come from Sydney Music's gig guide (read only up to Fri 20 Nov) and earlier checks; Wolf Alice, Hoodoo Gurus and Whispering Jack details weren't re-verified.
Groceries: only items confirmed in OzBargain's 18–24 Nov catalogue roundup are listed. No fresh fruit, veg, meat or egg half-price items were found, and Aldi's pages showed no prices.

Deals: PS5 controller and EB Games offers show a 2 Dec expiry on OzBargain; others carry over from yesterday and weren't all re-checked. Nothing new was found for Pokémon, Minecraft, Roblox or a junior parkrun.
